A '''captain''' commanded the [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liner]] ''[[Orramas]]'' in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. He shipped [[Abal Karda]], a fugitive from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] justice, to [[Maryx Minor/Legends|Maryx Minor]].
